verifications.claim: The coverage marks NBC's return to regular MLB broadcasting after a 25-year break.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NBC has a long history with baseball, albeit not much recently. The network carried games from 1939 through 1989. It was part of the short-lived Baseball Network with ABC in 1994 and ’95 and then aired playoff games from 1996 through 2000" (R1); "As NBC returns to baseball coverage for the first time in 25 years" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources indicate return after ~25 years since last regular/consistent coverage around 2000; minor variance in exact years but directly supports.
